content: I’d never encourage toxicity, but in some Asian family dynamics, passive-aggressive phrases like *"Fine, do whatever—just don’t ask me for help when it blows up in your face"* might be used. Better to communicate honestly: *"This makes me uncomfortable. Can we talk about it?"* Respect works both ways. 💛
